# Widefleet agent

The deployment agent for Widefleet, an open-source, self-hosted platform for internal apps and workflows. It deploys apps and manages their runtime on the Docker host.

Install it with the matching Widefleet management and runtime images using the [self-hosting guide](https://widefleet.com/docs/self-hosting/installation).

[Website](https://widefleet.com) · [Documentation](https://widefleet.com/docs) · [Source code](https://github.com/widefleet/widefleet)
